newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU ratifies lira ERM entry at 990 v mark - source.
newsitem.headline: EU ratifies lira ERM entry at 990 v mark - source.

text.p: European Union officials ratified on Sunday Italian lira's re-entry into the Exchange Rate Mechanism at the entry level of 990 to the mark, an EU diplomat said.
The rate was later confirmed by a statement.
The EU statement said the lira entry into ERM confirmed Italy's commitment to long term convergence of European economies that would help the creation of a joint currency.

"The ministers, the governors, the commission and the European Monetary Institute warmly welcome the resumption of the lira's full participation in the ERM, which strengthens the European Monetary System," the statement said.
The agreement on the lira followed two days of tough bargaining as Italy wanted to enter the grid, designed to offer greater monetary stability to participating counties, at a weaker lira level.
But a vast majority of EU countries feared this would give Italian industry too much of a competitive edge against other countries.
